# New Heavy Overeater design & 25% discount on everything in our merchandising shop ONLY on June 21st, 2023

![](/uploads/ajaxGallery_173_nukaknights-post-merchandising-shop-discount-heavy-overeater-2023-06-21.jpg)

![skywalka](/public/avatar_skywalka_fo76_nuka_knights_variant2_square_white-black.png) 

Our merchandising shop offers you the next discount promotion: **25% OFF on everything ONLY ON June 21st, 2023**

The Merchandising Shop is another channel to **support** us and **donate** in this form. In return you get cool shirts, sweaters, mugs and much more with a funny (perhaps ironic) saying or the Nuka Knights logo. If you have ideas for other sayings and motifs, please write in the comments.

### To the merchandising shop

Today we have a new design to celebrate: **Heavy Overeater**

Here you can see some examples of products with the new design. You'll find a lot more in the shop and you can also create your own products with your favorite motifs.
